reason: The squeeze tube packaging looks really neat, but I am not going to place a separate order on a website and wait three days for chutney when I get all my groceries in ten minutes on Blinkit.
objection: Why order online and wait 2 to 3 days when I can grab sauce from the local kirana or make it at home?
would_change_my_mind: List it on Blinkit or Zepto so I can add a tube directly to my quick-commerce cart.
